phys-fluid-01-c1.text: NOAA National Weather Service JetStream. Air Pressure. NOAA JetStream.
phys-fluid-01-c1.quote: The standard pressure at sea-level is 1013.25 in both millibars (mb) and hectopascal (hPa).
phys-fluid-01-c1.claim: The atmosphere around you at sea level sits at about 10⁵ Pa.

phys-fluid-01-c1.text: NOAA National Ocean Service. Does pressure change with ocean depth?. NOAA National Ocean Service.
phys-fluid-01-c1.quote: For every 33 feet (10.06 meters) you go down, the pressure increases by one atmosphere.
phys-fluid-01-c1.claim: each meter of water adds about 10⁴ Pa, roughly a tenth of an atmosphere.

phys-fluid-01-c2.text: Rod Nave, Georgia State University. Pascal's Principle. HyperPhysics, Georgia State University.
phys-fluid-01-c2.quote: Pressure is transmitted undiminished in an enclosed static fluid.
phys-fluid-01-c2.claim: a pressure change applied to a confined fluid is transmitted undiminished throughout.

phys-fluid-01-c3.text: Rod Nave, Georgia State University. Buoyancy. HyperPhysics, Georgia State University.
phys-fluid-01-c3.quote: The buoyant force on a submerged object is equal to the weight of the liquid displaced by the object.
phys-fluid-01-c3.claim: The buoyant force on a submerged object equals the weight of the fluid it displaces
